Name: Darker Nights and Less Blue Tint
Author: Nihilithh7
Description:
[size=4]Make your nights darker and reduce excessive blue tint with easy to use sliders in Generic Mod Config Menu. Useful for visual mod setups that make nighttime look too blue.[/size]

[list]
[*]Adjust blue tint reduction and extra darkness separately.[/*]
[*]Fine tune green tint for a warmer look.[/*]
[*]Effects gradually fade in at dusk.[/*]
[*]Daytime and interface colors stay unchanged.[/*]
[*]Optional nighttime correction for interiors.[/*]
[*]No performance impact.[/*]
[/list][b]Requirements:[/b] SMAPI. Install Generic Mod Config Menu for the sliders.

[b]Installation:[/b] Extract into your mods folder, launch through SMAPI, and adjust the settings in GMCM, if you want.

[i][b]Screenshots include other visual mods. Darkness also affects lamps and glows.[/b][/i]

[color=#0000ff]I dit not tested it too much, made for personal use. But if you see a bug / issue, report it, and make sure its caused from this mod.[/color]
